vocab.title: Match each expression to its meaning
defs: the person who replaces an employee who leaves
a case that does not follow the general rule
in most cases, as the normal practice
a period when the company stops opening new positions
the work of keeping the costs of a company under a limit
looking at each request on its own, not with one answer for all
the number of people who work in a team or a company
a position that the business cannot leave empty

items.situation: A manager asks: "Can I open a new position in January?"
tips: I'm afraid not. We don't open new positions during the freeze.
The rule in the present simple, with no apology after it.

items.situation: He asks why the freeze exists.
tips: It is part of the cost control plan for the year. Every company in the group follows it.

items.situation: An analyst resigns. The manager asks if he can replace her.
tips: As a rule, no. But a backfill for a critical role is an exception.
as a rule + but + the exception.
The committee decides on a case-by-case basis, every Thursday.
case-by-case: one request at a time.

items.situation: He asks what he can do this week.
tips: For the time being, let's split the work and hold off on the job posting.
for the time being = until the decision.

items.situation: He asks if temporary contracts are also frozen.
tips: Yes, unless the role is critical. Temporary contracts need approval too.

listenings.text: Good morning, everybody. Thank you for joining at short notice. I want to explain the hiring freeze before the news reaches the managers through other channels. From the first of November until the end of March, we don't open new positions in any company of the group. This is part of the cost control plan for next year, and it applies in every country, not only in South America. Our headcount stays where it is today. Now, the exceptions. A backfill for a critical role can go ahead, but it needs the approval of the regional committee. The committee looks at each request on a case-by-case basis, every Thursday. As a rule, a critical role is a position that the regulator requires, or a position that stops a business line if it stays empty. Everything else waits until April.

Hi Camila, it's Rafael, from the rental company in Chile. I'm calling about the freeze. I understand the rule, and I'm not asking for a new position. My problem is different. Our only fleet controller resigns at the end of the month, and nobody else on the team does that job. Without that person, we don't close the monthly fleet report, and the leasing contracts can't be renewed. So I think this is a backfill, not a new position, and I think it is a critical role. I can send you the job description and the numbers from last month today. For the time being, I'm holding off on the job posting, so nothing goes out before you tell me. Can you take it to the committee on Thursday? Call me back when you can. Thanks.
